info.title: rsna-knee-trainkit
info.description: Training code, label tables and a pack index for private training runs. Third-party files keep their own licences: the timm ImageNet weights (see their model cards) and, when present, convnext_small_s6fall_enc.safetensors, converted from nartaa's rsna-knee-s6fall-weights (heliosli's S6 network), licensed CC BY-NC 4.0.
